references.text: Jeremiah warns against prophets who speak lies in the Lord's name, whom He has not sent or commanded to speak
The Lord says that He did not send the prophets who nevertheless ran, and that He did not speak to them, yet they prophesied anyway
Prophets who speak lies and prophesy the deceit of their own hearts in the Lord's name
Ezekiel prophesies against prophets who prophesy from their own hearts and follow their own spirit
False prophets who see lies and predict deception, saying 'The Lord says' when the Lord has not sent them
The one who speaks lies in the Lord's name shall be pierced; this is the punishment for false prophecy
The warning against prophets who will lead the people to follow other gods, and the punishment for this
Jesus warns against false prophets who come in sheep's clothing but are ravenous wolves
Many false prophets will arise and lead many astray
John warns to test the spirits, for many false prophets have gone out into the world
